text:
If you’re heading out for the last bit of daylight, sunset at 6:44 should have a decent shot at staying mostly clear, with clouds likely filling in afterward. Tonight turns mostly cloudy and cool, settling near 52, with a north wind easing to 5 to 9 mph. Air quality is good, and the lake is still a comfortable 64, though north winds will keep the waterfront feeling sharper than town.

Saturday looks mostly cloudy with a high near 70 and a north wind building from 10 to 15 mph toward 15 to 20. The forecast is trending drier, but the models aren’t fully aligned, the Euro keeps a better chance of a shower than the others. I’d plan on a dry day with a light rain jacket tucked along, especially if you’re spending time by the water. Waves should run 1 to 2 feet, so Saturday is better for a short shoreline outing than a long open-water trip.
